pieces.title: You cannot un-salt it
pieces.caption: A plucked phrase three times: dry, with reverb, and after an honest try at taking the reverb back out. The third is choppier and still wet. *What is real and what is a choice:* The 'taking out' is a simple gate. Better tools exist and they do not get the dry phrase back either. *Leaking in:* Reverb ↔ Space-Time, the sibling bridge whose effect is the salt.
